character.name: Norio
character.text:
Instead of an attack attempt, draw 2 cards or restore 1 life to anyone. Once per turn, you may move any Effect on the table. A {Polearm} may block an attack as an Intervention.
{After your death} each ally may remove an Effect from themselves.

character.name: Taranaga
character.text:
In the draw phase, +1 card. When robbed, stunned or hit by a group action, you give a card of your choice. You may play an Aura in front of any player.
{After your death} pass your Aura to a living ally.

character.name: Iyo
character.text:
Once per turn, move your Trap to an ally without one, or swap any two Traps on the table unseen. Your Trap triggers on thrown attacks too. In the draw phase, +1 card per Trap on the table (up to 3).
{After your death} enemy Traps are revealed.

character.name: Saigo
character.text:
You may take a dead player's Stance into your hand. Bare hands deal 2. In the draw phase, +1 card per Stance on the table (up to 3).
{After your death} your Stance stays, and enemies return their Stances to hand.

1.name: Katana
1.text: While you hold a Stance, deal 1 extra wound.

3.name: Kanabo
3.text:
On a successful attack, the target discards a random card.
Favourite weapon of {Saigo}.

4.name: Bokken
4.text: On a successful attack, you or an ally draws a card.

5.name: Traitor's Dagger
5.text:
In the {Assassin} stance, deals 1 extra wound.
A {Ninja}'s strike cannot be defended and ignores Traps.

8.name: Wakizashi
8.text: May be played as a modifier on a Katana attack: +2 attack power.

9.name: Spiked Shield
9.text: May be played as a Defense card. In the {Shield Bearer} stance, deals 1 extra wound.

10.name: Tonfa
10.text: On a successful attack, the target discards a random card. TODO: exact twin of Yawara #19 — differentiate or remove (draft since 18.09.2026).

12.name: Shogun's Blade
12.text: Only the Shogun may make a direct attack with this weapon. May be played as an Intervention to hand this card to the Shogun in exchange for another, face down.

18.name: Sai
18.text: This weapon may be played as a Defense.

19.name: Yawara
19.text: On a successful attack, the target discards a random card. TODO: exact twin of Tonfa #10 — differentiate or remove (draft since 18.09.2026).

24.name: Bo
24.text:
{Polearm} On a successful attack, the target loses their Stance; {Saigo} keeps his.
Favourite weapon of {Norio}.

26.name: Kyoketsu-shoge
26.text:
On a successful attack, take a card from the enemy's hand.
Favourite weapon of {Taka}.

27.name: Manriki
27.text: On a successful attack, take a card from the enemy's hand.

29.name: Yari
29.text: {Polearm} In the {Horseman} stance, deals 1 extra wound.

30.name: Kamayari
30.text: {Polearm} In the {Horseman} stance, deals 1 extra wound.

31.name: Yari
31.text: {Polearm} In the {Horseman} stance, deals 1 extra wound.

32.name: Shuriken
32.text: {With a Trap in play} deals one wound more.

33.name: Daikyu
33.text: In the {Archer} stance, deals 1 extra wound.

1033.name: Teppo Yumi
1033.text: Fires only together with a Modifier.

34.name: Shuriken
34.text: {With a Trap in play} deals one wound more.

36.name: Boomerang
36.text: On a successful attack, this weapon returns to your hand.

37.name: Daikyu
37.text: In the {Archer} stance, deals 1 extra wound.

38.name: Makibishi
38.text:
May be played as a Trap that deals 1 wound back to the attacker.
Favourite weapon of {Iyo}.

39.name: Poison Dart
39.text:
This attack ignores Traps and Defense, and you draw a card.
{Minamoto} deals two wounds with it.

318.name: Uchine
318.text: If your attack is stopped by a Defense, the weapon comes back to your hand along its cord.

319.name: Sodegarami
319.text: {Polearm} TODO: capture instead of damage. The intent — it takes a card from the target's hand instead of dealing wounds: the sleeve entangler brought a man down without killing him. Needs separating from the Manriki #27 and the Kyoketsu-shoge #26, which already take a card on a successful attack.

320.name: Fukiya
320.text: The shot does not use up an attack.

321.name: Saihai
321.text: TODO: this is not a weapon. Attack power 0 — it cannot strike at all. The intent is that the baton commands: it decides who draws cards or who acts next. Decide whether the card stays in the weapon group or moves to actions.

322.name: Otsuchi
322.text: Strikes only as your first attack of the turn.

323.name: Nagamaki
323.text: Strikes only as your first attack of the turn.

324.name: Kodachi
324.text: Strikes only as your second attack of the turn. If the attack is stopped, the attempt is not used up.

41.name: Snare
41.text: Take three cards from the attacker.

42.name: Straw Decoy
42.text: The attack fails and the defender draws 2 cards.

43.name: Bear Trap
43.text: The attacker takes two wounds from the Trap's owner. Then this card moves onto them as an Effect: attacks against them are always complexity 1 — Armor and other complexity increases do not help.

45.name: Death Cap
45.text: The attacker is Poisoned; if they are Poisoned already, deal them 3 wounds instead.

47.name: Insult
47.text: You insult the attacker. For a {Samurai} this is worse than death: they take this card as an Effect of rage and must discard a card with every direct attack.

1048.name: Phoenix Breath
1048.text: If you survive the attack, restore all your life.

1049.name: Puncture Wounds
1049.text: Passes to the attacker as an Effect: they can no longer use weapons for direct attacks.

1050.name: Bell
1050.text: When it is triggered, any {ally} may play their own Trap in its place as an Intervention — from hand or from the table.

49.name: Hidden Dagger
49.text:
The attacker takes 1 wound from you. {At death's door} the enemy takes 3 wounds instead.
{With a Trap in play} deal 1 more wound.

52.name: Benkei's Miracle
52.text:
Choose how many wounds you take from this attack, and draw a card for each wound taken (no more than three).
{Ushiwaka} also takes the attacker's weapon into hand.

53.name: Pickpocket
53.text: You also take a random card from the attacker.

54.name: Stagger
54.text:
The attacker discards a random card.
In the {Shield Bearer} stance, draw a card.

55.name: Seize
55.text:
Take the enemy's non-thrown weapon into your hand; {Hanzo} takes any weapon, thrown ones included.
{With a Stance in play} also draw a card.

44.name: Ricochet
44.text: The attack fails and rebounds at the weapon's base power. The attacker may defend against the ricochet.

56.name: Block
56.text: May be played at any time, for any player.

57.name: Shadow
57.text: You count as dead to the other players for the whole round, but you discard this Stance at the start of your turn.

58.name: Horseman
58.text: Attacks against you are 1 harder. Your weapon handles 1 more complexity. Attacking complexity 1, you deal 1 extra wound.

59.name: Lotus
59.text:
When played, restore 2 life.
Before each draw phase you may: restore 1 life to any player {OR} draw a card.

60.name: Shield Bearer
60.text:
Reduce every direct attack against you by 1 wound. You may discard a card from your hand for each further reduction (never below 1).
Whenever you play a Defense, draw a card.

61.name: Blade Master
61.text:
When you attack, choose: deal 1 extra wound {OR} draw a card.
{On a successful direct attack} restore 1 life.

62.name: Chaplain
62.text:
Once per turn you may: restore 1 life to any player -OR- discard a card to clear Poison or one Effect from any player.
{Samurai} do not have to discard.

63.name: Assassin
63.text:
When you attack an enemy you may: make your attack Poisoned -OR- discard 2 cards to leave the enemy defenseless against it.
{Ninja} discard only 1 card.
{On killing a player} draw 2 cards.

1164.name: Ketsuban
1164.text: When you take wounds from a weapon, you may choose a willing ally to share those wounds with you in any split.

1165.name: Mushin
1165.text:
{At full health} draw 2 cards when you make a direct attack.
{At death's door} your attacks deal 2 extra wounds.

1166.name: Archer
1166.text:
Your thrown attacks deal +1 wound.
On a successful attack against a player who has a Trap, draw a card.

64.name: Vial of Poison
64.text: Your attack now inflicts Poison and deals 1 extra wound.

66.name: Yin and Yang
66.text: Swap the range and the power of the attack.

67.name: Shadow Strike
67.text:
Your attack ignores Traps and cannot be defended.
{Ninja} deal 1 extra wound.
{Samurai} pay the price of a discarded card.

68.name: Lunge
68.text:
+1 attack power. Your weapon handles 2 more complexity.
{With a Stance in play} deal 1 more wound.

69.name: Wind Step
69.text: Your attack cannot be defended, but Traps still work. (merged into Shadow Strike)

70.name: Shogun's Wrath
70.text: This attack may be made even against a player at death's door.

71.name: Thirsting Blade
71.text:
On a successful attack, restore as much life as the wounds you dealt.
{Taka} may instead take that many cards from the target's hand.

72.name: Burst of Fury
72.text: The attack strikes two targets at once, but its power and range are each reduced by 1. WAY TOO COMPLICATED

73.name: Hachimaki
73.text:
Your attack handles any complexity and deals 1 extra wound, but you lose 1 life.
{At death's door} it cannot be played.

74.name: Throw
74.text: Turns your weapon into a thrown weapon with base power 1.

75.name: Crushing Blow
75.text: The attack's final power equals your current life.

76.name: Boiling Venom
76.text: A Poisoned target takes 2 extra wounds.

77.name: Shogun's Hand
77.text:
This strike does not use up your attack.
{Samurai} deal 1 extra wound.
{Ninja} pay the price of a discarded card.

78.name: Shogun's Spirit
78.text: Your attack cannot be defended and Traps have no effect. (merged into Shadow Strike)

79.name: Piercing Strike
79.text: Your weapon attack completely ignores every bonus from the target's Stance, Character and Effects.

1081.name: Finishing Blow
1081.text: The attack's final power equals the target's missing life.

1083.name: Kubitori
1083.text:
+1 attack power. If this attack kills the enemy, you may take their Stance, Aura and any Effects for yourself.
The only way to take {Saigo}'s Stance.

1084.name: Victor's Strike
1084.text: Add your current victory points to the attack's power.

1032.name: Renkei
1032.text: Play it on your attack or an {ally}'s attack. Any ally may then put a Modifier on top of it as an Intervention.

81.name: Onsen
81.text: Fully restore your life and clear every Effect and Poison from yourself; each other living player gains 1 life. -OR- Every living player gains 2 life and clears Poison.

82.name: Peacemakers
82.text: Each other living player discards a Defense or a Weapon, or hands you a card of their choice from their hand.

83.name: Brawl
83.text:
Every other living player loses their Stance and discards their Trap.
{Saigo} stays out of the brawl.

84.name: Tea Ceremony
84.text: You draw 4 cards and each other living player draws 1. -OR- Every living player draws 2 cards.

85.name: Revelation
85.text: Every Trap on the table except yours is revealed, but stays in play. Draw a card for each Trap revealed (no more than three).

86.name: Whirlwind of Fury
86.text: Played together with a non-thrown weapon that handles complexity 2 or higher. Ignoring Traps, every living player takes the weapon's damage (no bonuses) or discards a Defense. Uses up your attack. TODO: rework. Since seating no longer matters, «a non-thrown weapon of complexity 2+» only describes armour-piercing weapons and says nothing about the sweep — consider tying it to the {Polearm} class instead: the whirlwind is a circular polearm strike. Also decide whether it hits allies (currently every living player).

87.name: Storm of Fire
87.text: Play this card and spend any other cards from your hand to throw a ranged attack of power 1 at another player for each one. These may be defended. At most 1 hit per target. Uses up your attack. TODO: rework. From the to-do list: turn it into a shared spare — allies chip in thrown weapons from their hands — or drop «uses up your attack».

88.name: Acid Burst
88.text:
A player of your choice loses 1 life for every Poison on the table.
{Under the Barrel of Stench} you may blow it up: the aura stays in play, and every enemy becomes Poisoned.

89.name: Arrow Storm
89.text: Every Trap on the table goes to the discard pile. (merged into Brawl)

90.name: War Cry
90.text: Each other living player discards a Defense card or loses 2 life. TODO: rework. Open question from the to-do list — who gets the victory point when the cry finishes a player; under the thrust rule it goes to whoever played the card, confirm that is the intent.

3091.name: Inspection
3091.text: Each other living player lays out one card of their choice face up. After looking them over, you may take any one of those cards into your hand.

3092.name: ?Clan Gathering 1?
3092.text: For each living ally, your allies each draw a card.

3093.name: ?Clan Gathering 2?
3093.text: For each living ally, your allies each restore 1 life.

3094.name: Cry of Vengeance
3094.text: Every enemy takes an attack with power equal to the number of your allies at death's door. This cannot be defended.

1094.name: Relay of Blades
1094.text: Every living player picks 1 card from their hand and places it face down in front of them. Once all are down, the cards shift one seat clockwise (each player takes the face-down card of the neighbour on their right).

1137.name: War Council
1137.text: Every living ally lays out one card face up in front of them, and you decide which ally gets which. No one may keep their own card.

1138.name: Blood Kin
1138.text: Redistribute life among your living allies however you see fit.

1139.name: Side by Side
1139.text:
You deal 1 wound.
Each ally may play a weapon card as an Intervention to add 1 more wound - at most one card per player.

91.name: Killer's Mark
91.text:
Every attack against you deals 1 extra wound, and the attacker draws a card.
{The player who kills you} draws two cards.

92.name: Antidote
92.text: You cannot be Poisoned. Any Poison on you is cleared.

93.name: Snakebite
93.text:
Every point of healing on this player is reduced by 1, and every penalty from Poison is doubled. While you are Poisoned, you cannot use Stance bonuses.
Has no effect on {Minamoto}.

94.name: Kaginawa
94.text: Attacks against you are always complexity 1 — Armor and other complexity increases do not help.

95.name: Disarm
95.text:
The chosen player cannot make direct weapon attacks.
{Samurai} must discard a card to attack you.

96.name: Smoke Screen
96.text: TODO: For the next turn the chosen player counts as being at death's door. DO SOMETHING with this card! Maybe move it from Intervention into a Stance?

97.name: Dust in the Eyes
97.text: Your attacks may only take complexity 1, and you cannot use thrown weapons.

99.name: Incense Bowl
99.text: The chosen player discards an Effect you name. For each extra card discarded, one more Effect may be removed. For every Effect removed this way, restore 1 life to any player. {Norio} removes any number of Effects without discarding cards.

100.name: Weakness
100.text: Your attacks cannot deal more than one wound.

101.name: Defenseless
101.text: This player cannot defend against attacks.

102.name: Leader's Spirit
102.text: The chosen player draws one extra card in the draw phase. TODO: remove?

103.name: Exhaustion
103.text: You may make one fewer direct attack per turn.

104.name: Aegis
104.text: The chosen player automatically defends against an attack. New mechanic — the game already lets plenty of players help with defending.

4104.name: Curse
4104.text: You take 2 extra wounds from any kind of damage. The Curse passes to the player who kills you.

105.name: Wasabi
105.text: The chosen player is cured of Poison, restores 1 life and draws a card.

106.name: Ancestral Call
106.text: Every living player, you included, lays one card from hand face up in front of them. You take one of them; the rest go back to their owners.

107.name: Stitches
107.text:
Any living player of your choice restores 2 life. In the {Chaplain} stance, restore 1 life more.
{At death's door} you may heal another player for 3 life.

108.name: Seppuku
108.text:
Lay all your cards face up in front of you. Your living allies may take any of them, up to the limit of 8 cards; the rest go to the discard pile. You then die and another player scores a victory point. You cannot lose your last victory point this way.
{Ninja} cannot commit Seppuku.

109.name: Sake
109.text: Discard this card to draw 1 new card. Then draw 1 more card for each card you discard (no more than two). {Allies} may help you draw by discarding cards of their own, but no more than two each.

110.name: Battle Banana
110.text: Another living player of your choice discards their current Stance, and you draw a card for it. Or discard this card to draw two new ones. TODO: remove carD entirelly? Or make something else based on having a condition of having STAANCE?

111.name: Betrayal
111.text:
Discard a victory point (unless it is your last) and draw seven cards for it. This does not count as death.
{Samurai} cannot betray.

112.name: Sapper
112.text:
Disarm any Trap on the table; {Iyo} may take it into her hand instead.
Or discard two cards with the same name to draw two new ones; a poisoned and a plain version of a weapon count as the same.

113.name: Equilibrium
113.text:
The chosen player's life becomes equal to yours.
A {Ninja} must discard a card to take this action.

114.name: Respite
114.text:
Restore all your missing life. Any other player of your choice draws a card.
{At full health} they draw two instead, and you may keep the cards yourself.

115.name: Clairvoyance
115.text:
The chosen player reveals their hand to everyone until the next action.
A {Ninja} may take any one of those cards.

116.name: Fugu Poison
116.text: Poisons the chosen living player; {Minamoto} may poison herself. If Minamoto is poisoned by this card, she draws two cards.

117.name: Soul Swap
117.text:
You and the chosen player swap life totals.
A {Samurai} must discard a card to take this action.

118.name: Magatama
118.text: Either play this card to draw four new cards, or keep it to score a victory point.

119.name: Blood Transfusion
119.text: Cures any player of Poison and passes it to any other. UPD: merged into the Voodoo Doll

120.name: Blood Sacrifice
120.text: Play this card and draw a new card for every life you spend (never your last, no more than three). {Ushiwaka} may play it at any moment, even on another player's turn.

1121.name: Kampo
1121.text: Play this card and discard as many cards as you need, restoring 1 life for each.

1122.name: Death Throes
1122.text:
Play this card and draw 1 card for every point of life you are missing.
{If you are Poisoned}, draw 1 more card on top of that.

31121.name: Burning Coal
31121.text: Pass this card face up to a living enemy — from a {Samurai} to a {Ninja} or back, never within a team; in exchange they must give you one card of their choice, face down. This card never goes to the discard pile.

101122.name: Looter
101122.text: The chosen player lays their whole hand face up. You and each of your {allies} take one of those cards.

1123.name: Soul Mirror
1123.text: Play this card to trigger the abilities any player's Character performs {after death}, as if they were your ally.

1124.name: Infiltrator
1124.text: You take the Aura of the chosen living player for yourself.

1125.name: Relay
1125.text: Move an active Aura from one {ally} to another, with the consent of both. Either of them may be you.

121.name: Mending
121.text: Restore all life to a Poisoned player and clear the Poison itself.

122.name: Death by Fugu
122.text: Play this card to deal two wounds to a Poisoned player.

123.name: Ginger
123.text: Play this card to restore one life to any player. You may play it paired with a {Wasabi} from your hand — then it restores two.

124.name: Dragon Strike
124.text: Play this card to deal one wound to any player of your choice. You may play it paired with a {Yari} from your hand — then it deals two wounds.

125.name: Feat of Valor
125.text:
Play this card to take a direct weapon attack onto yourself.
{At death's door} your allies each draw a card.
{Samurai} take one wound less doing so.

126.name: Helping Hand
126.text: Play this card to let any player on your team pass a card from their hand, face down, to another player on the team — they choose both the card and the recipient.

127.name: Message
127.text: Play this card to pass any other card from your hand to any player, face down. (merged into Helping Hand)

128.name: Feigned Death
128.text: The chosen player, with their consent, plays dead until the end of the current turn: they keep 1 life, and their Aura does not work.

1029.name: Shattered Steel
1029.text: Destroys a weapon played on the table: the card goes to the discard pile and the attack is cancelled without using up the attempt. TODO: what happens when Shards break a weapon Hanzo is defending with — a dedicated interaction.

1030.name: Yokai's Slumber
1030.text: The chosen player's next action ends their turn. Discarding paired cards does not count. TODO: unclear what to do with this card — moved to drafts 18.09.2026.

1031.name: Shieldbreaker
1031.text: Play in response to a Defense card: it is destroyed and the attack resolves as if undefended.

129.name: Sleight of Hand
129.text: Take one random card from the hand of any living player. {Taka} takes two.

130.name: Voodoo Doll
130.text: Choose a Poison or any Effect on the table and move it onto any player.

131.name: Datura
131.text: You take a chosen Effect off a player and onto yourself. UPD: merged into the Voodoo Doll

132.name: Ketsu Nugi
132.text:
Take one life from a player and add it to your own.
{If you are Poisoned}, you pass the Poison to that player instead.

133.name: Intercept
133.text: TODO: is this card needed once Sapper is reworked? You take another player's Trap into your hand. UPD: Into sapper

1133.name: Kamikaze
1133.text: You and a willing living {ally} discard all your cards — hand and table — and you kill the chosen enemy.

1134.name: All In
1134.text: You swap your entire hand, face down, with the chosen living player.

1135.name: Yokai
1135.text: Take any other player's card from the table — face up or face down — into your hand.

1136.name: Blind Strike
1136.text: The chosen player's current and missing life swap places.

135.name: Ushiwaka
135.text:
Draw a card for every wound you take. Death's door for you: 1 or 2 life.
{After your death} enemies take 1 wound.

136.name: Taranaga
136.text:
In the draw phase, +1 card. When robbed, stunned or hit by a group action, you give a card of your choice. You may play an Aura in front of any player.
{After your death} pass your Aura to a living ally.

137.name: Saigo
137.text:
You may take a dead player's Stance into your hand. Bare hands deal 2. In the draw phase, +1 card per Stance on the table (up to 3).
{After your death} your Stance stays, and enemies return their Stances to hand.

138.name: Hanzo
138.text:
You may block direct attacks with a weapon at the cost of one wound. You may discard a Defense to draw 2.
{After your death} discard any number of Weapons: a thrust for 1 wound each, all at one enemy.

142.name: Norio
142.text:
Instead of an attack attempt, draw 2 cards or restore 1 life to anyone. Once per turn, you may move any Effect on the table. A {Polearm} may block an attack as an Intervention.
{After your death} each ally may remove an Effect from themselves.

139.name: Iyo
139.text:
Once per turn, move your Trap to an ally without one, or swap any two Traps on the table unseen. Your Trap triggers on thrown attacks too. In the draw phase, +1 card per Trap on the table (up to 3).
{After your death} enemy Traps are revealed.

140.name: Taka
140.text:
Once per turn: take a card of a player's choice from them, or give them one of yours. Once per turn: discard 2 cards to draw 3.
{After your death} you may give allies a card each, face down.

145.name: Manase
145.text:
Your healing cures poison and goes 1 life above the limit; for cards and markers the limit is unchanged. Whenever a teammate heals, draw a card, however much was restored.
{After your death} allies restore 1 life and are cured of poison.

146.name: Minamoto
146.text:
Poison costs you no life, and a poison death's point is yours, not the discard's. {If you are poisoned}: your attacks are poisoned, 3 attempts per turn, and whoever wounds you with a direct attack is poisoned. In the draw phase, +1 card per poisoned player (up to 3).
{After your death} every enemy is poisoned.

1200.name: Martial Mastery
1200.text: On their turn any ally may tuck any number of Modifiers face up under the Aura. For every two, all attacks by {allies} deal +1 wound, up to +3 in total.

1201.name: Covered Flank
1201.text: On their turn any ally may tuck one Defense card face up under the Aura. For every two, all {allies} take one wound less from any direct attack (never below 1), up to three in total.

1202.name: Closed Ranks
1202.text: Attacks against your team are 1 harder.

1203.name: Barrel of Stench
1203.text:
All direct weapon attacks by {allies} are automatically Poisoned, as if a poisoned weapon had been used.
The {Bearer} becomes Poisoned.

1204.name: Back to Back
1204.text: Any {ally} may play a Defense card as an Intervention to defend another ally — as a full defense. However, the Aura's {Bearer} loses the ability to play Defense cards in any form.

1205.name: Strategist
1205.text: On their turn any ally may tuck one Intervention or Group Action face up under the Aura. For every two cards, in the draw phase each {ally} takes +1 card from the deck, up to +2 in total.

1207.name: Oath
1207.text: Any living {ally} may consent to take a direct weapon attack aimed at another ally onto themselves (as with Feat of Valor), but takes one wound more.

1208.name: Field Medicine
1208.text: Any healing of {allies} restores 1 extra life. Swapping, equalising or moving life does not count as healing.

1209.name: Sentry
1209.text:
{Enemies} who wound your allies with a direct attack take 1 wound from the Aura's bearer, or 2 if the bearer is in the {Archer} stance.
The {Bearer} cannot use thrown weapons.

1210.name: Armory
1210.text: When a direct weapon attack is made (before the defender acts), any {ally} may, with the attacker's consent, put a weapon into play as an Intervention and take the attacker's weapon for themselves.

1211.name: Shadow Network
1211.text: Once per turn any {ally} may swap cards face down with a comrade, by mutual consent.

1212.name: High Ground
1212.text: On their turn any ally may tuck one thrown weapon face up under the Aura. For every full set — one weapon per living player on your team — thrown attacks by {allies} deal +1 wound, up to +3 in total.

1213.name: Yokai's Slumber
1213.text: May be played in front of you at any moment. The {Bearer}'s hand lies face up in front of them. {Allies} may play these cards as their own.
